name: paperpilot-research-workflow
description: Codex plugin and skill for applying PaperPilot's human-guided economics and finance research workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Guide one finance or economics paper with PaperPilot.
interface.longDescription: Apply PaperPilot's human-guided workflow for serious economics and finance research: idea screening, question formation, literature positioning, data-permission planning, empirical design, analysis outputs, claim discipline, writing revision, reviewer stress tests, AFA-style documentation, multi-agent coordination, and journal-quality scoring.
defaultPrompt: Use PaperPilot to start a research paper workflow.
Summarize the PaperPilot repo for a new researcher.
Run PaperPilot from the current stage to final review.
